frame.name: Precision Frame
frame.description: Fires a long-range precision energy bolt. This weapon's recoil pattern is more predictably vertical.

origins.name: Willing Vessel
origins.description: Dealing damage or defeating targets with this weapon gradually grants increased stability, handling, reload speed, and charge rate. This effect gradually decreases over time but is gained more quickly while near allies.

origins.name: Runneth Over
origins.description: Reloading near allies overflows the magazine. Bows receive faster draw time and Swords receive faster charge rate.

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

enhanced.name: Subsistence
enhanced.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves with an increased amount of ammo.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

enhanced.name: Ambitious Assassin
enhanced.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid final blows before reloading. Improves reload.

perks.name: Overflow
perks.description: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo automatically loads this weapon beyond normal capacity.

enhanced.name: Overflow
enhanced.description: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo loads this weapon even further beyond normal capacity.

perks.name: Triple Tap
perks.description: Rapidly landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.

enhanced.name: Triple Tap
enhanced.description: Landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.description: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

enhanced.name: Field Prep
enhanced.description: Greatly increases ammo generation. Improves reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Perfect Float
perks.description: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne effectiveness and reduces flinch until you are out of combat.

enhanced.name: Perfect Float
enhanced.description: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne accuracy and reduces flinch until you are out of combat for an extended duration.

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.description: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

enhanced.name: Hip-Fire Grip
enhanced.description: Greatly increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Reservoir Burst
perks.description: When the battery is full, your next burst deals additional damage and causes enemies to explode on death.

enhanced.name: Reservoir Burst
enhanced.description: When the battery is full, your next burst is improved, dealing additional damage and causing targets to explode when defeated.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

enhanced.name: Frenzy
enhanced.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon for an improved duration until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Adagio
perks.description: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for a brief time.

enhanced.name: Adagio
enhanced.description: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for an improved time.

perks.name: Discord
perks.description: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

enhanced.name: Discord
enhanced.description: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a longer duration. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

enhanced.name: Chain Reaction
enhanced.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an improved elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Withering Gaze
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.

enhanced.name: Withering Gaze
enhanced.description: Aiming this weapon for a shorter period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

enhanced.name: Successful Warm-Up
enhanced.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed for an improved duration.
